# Adrian Headley Tools

> Free browser-based utilities for text, files, PDFs, images, security, media, conversions and everyday tasks.

Canonical site: https://tools.adrianheadley.com/
Language: English (UK)

## Core pages
- [Tools](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/): Browse all tools.
- [About](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/about.html): How the site and browser tools work.
- [Privacy](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/privacy.html): Privacy and processing information.
- [Terms](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/terms.html): Terms of use.
- [Security & Trust](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/security.html): Operator, privacy, software supply-chain, download safety and vulnerability reporting information.

## Tools
- [ASCII Art Generator](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/ascii-art.html): Turn text or an image into ASCII-style artwork directly in your browser, with controls for font, size and image detail.
- [Barcode Generator](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/barcode-generator.html): Create a simple Code 39 barcode with a generated numeric value and optional descriptive labels.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/date-difference.html): Calculate the exact amount of time between two dates or moments.
- [DNS Lookup](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/dns-lookup.html): Advanced passive domain intelligence covering RDAP registration, expiry and possible release timing, registrar abuse contacts, DNS analysis, email security, Certificate Transparency hostnames, nameserver/mail infrastructure, ASN routing, RPKI and raw data.
- [Fake Information Generator](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/fake-information-generator.html): Generate realistic-looking but fictional placeholder identity information for testing, demos and mock-ups.
- [File Compressor](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/file-compressor.html): Reduce the size of supported files using browser-based compression controls.
- [File Converter](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/file-converter.html): Convert one or multiple supported files between common formats; multiple outputs download together as a ZIP.
- [Find & Replace](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/find-and-replace.html): Search through text and replace matching words, phrases or characters quickly.
- [Hashing Tool](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/hashing.html): Create cryptographic hashes for text or files and compare content using several SHA algorithms.
- [Image Colour Picker](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/colour-picker.html): Inspect colours from an uploaded image or use the browser's screen eyedropper where that feature is supported.
- [Image Resizer](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/image-resizer.html): Resize an image to new dimensions while controlling how it fits or fills the target area.
- [Merge PDFs](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/merge-pdfs.html): Combine multiple PDF files into a single document in your chosen order.
- [Metadata Reader](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/metadata-reader.html): Inspect available EXIF, IPTC and XMP metadata from supported files without sending the file to a remote metadata service.
- [Metadata Remover & Editor](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/metadata-remover.html): Remove, replace or add supported metadata fields such as GPS, device information and software details.
- [OCR Reader](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/ocr-reader.html): Use optical character recognition to extract readable text from images or PDF pages.
- [PDF Separator](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/pdf-separator.html): Separate a PDF into individual page files or selected page ranges.
- [Powerful Websites](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/powerful-sites.html): Browse a curated collection of useful websites, online tools and resources across a wide range of categories.
- [QR Code Generator](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/qr-code-generator.html): Create a custom QR code for a link or other text with configurable colours, shapes and an optional embedded logo.
- [Random Picker / Spinner](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/random-spinner.html): Choose a random result from your own list using a weighted spinning wheel.
- [Route Planner](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/route-planner.html): Plan and optimise a driving route containing multiple stops using postcodes, full addresses or coordinates.
- [Steganography Toolkit](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/steganography.html): Hide, reveal or remove concealed information in supported text, image, video and file formats.
- [Teleprompter](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/teleprompter.html): Display scrolling script text over a camera or shared-screen preview for presenting and recording.
- [Temporary Email](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/temp-email.html): Create a temporary receive-only email address for short-term sign-ups or testing.
- [Text Case Converter](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/text-case-converter.html): Change text between common letter-case formats instantly.
- [Text Difference Checker](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/text-difference.html): Compare two pieces of text and highlight what has been added, removed or changed.
- [Text Encrypter / Decrypter](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/encrypt-decrypt.html): Encrypt and decrypt text locally using AES-GCM browser cryptography.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/time-zone-converter.html): Convert a date and time from one time zone into another.
- [Typing Speed Test](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/typing-speed-test.html): Measure typing speed and accuracy using generated passages and live per-character feedback.
- [Unit Converter](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/unit-converter.html): Convert a value between compatible measurement units.
- [URL Lengthener](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/url-lengthener.html): Create a deliberately longer version of a URL for novelty or testing.
- [URL Shortener](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/url-shortener.html): Create a shorter version of a long web address using an online shortening service.
- [Video Editor](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/video-editor.html): Edit video, images, text and audio on a multi-track timeline directly in your browser.
- [Email Domain Analyzer](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/email-domain-analyzer.html): Analyse an email domain for mail acceptance, MX/provider, SPF, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, DNSSEC clues, common DKIM selectors and temporary-email indicators without probing a mailbox.
- [Email Header Analyzer](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/email-header-analyzer.html): Deep local email-header analysis for delivery hops, recipients, public IPs, SPF/DKIM/DMARC/ARC, automation and bulk-mail clues, sender services, threads, MIME/attachments and security headers.
- [IP & ASN Lookup](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/ip-asn-lookup.html): Inspect a public IP address or ASN for network ownership, prefix, reverse DNS, routing, RPKI, abuse contacts, announced prefixes, routing neighbours and approximate public IP geolocation.
- [Public Document Finder](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/public-document-finder.html): Find publicly indexed and Wayback-archived PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, presentations and other document formats by keyword, organisation or domain.
- [Username, Name & Contact OSINT](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/username-osint.html): Search current public profiles and Wayback Machine history by username, real name, email or phone, with optional public cross-reference clues.
- [Word & Character Counter](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/word-character-counter.html): Count words, characters, lines, sentences, paragraphs and writing-time estimates as you type.

This file is a supplementary machine-readable index. The canonical HTML pages and sitemap are the primary source of site content.

- [Browser Code Studio](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/coding-studio.html): Browser-based project editor with local session storage, HTML/CSS/JavaScript preview, standalone JavaScript execution, optional in-browser Python through Pyodide, .ahcode project save/load with legacy ZIP import, coder-only light/dark mode and a local coding coach.

- [Income Tax Calculator](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/income-tax-calculator.html): Estimate annual UK Income Tax for one or more jobs, common PAYE tax codes and standard or Scottish tax bands.
- [Investment Calculator](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/investment-calculator.html): Project investment growth, contributions, fees and selected UK tax outcomes across common account wrappers and investment types.

- [PDF Editor](https://tools.adrianheadley.com/pages/toolpages/pdf-editor.html): Premium browser PDF editor with a large crisp Fit-width document, non-blocking PDF rendering, direct/matched text, exact embedded-font reuse where available, drawing, highlighting, whiteout, signatures, custom stamps and page management.
